sources.entry: macOS GateKeeper Helper - Simple macOS GateKeeper script. It helps you to control your GateKeeper.

summary.one_liner: A simple macOS script (GateKeeper_Helper.command) for checking and adjusting the system's GateKeeper security settings and quarantine status of apps.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a small tool that lets users show GateKeeper status, enable GateKeeper, and disable GateKeeper. It can also remove an app from GateKeeper quarantine and self-sign an app. The README explains GateKeeper as the macOS feature that enforces code signing and verifies downloaded apps before they run. The tool is distributed as a single .command file that is downloaded and run. The README does not describe how the script performs these actions internally.
use_cases: Fix 'app is damaged and can't be opened' error on macOS
Open a .pkg from an unidentified developer
Remove quarantine flag from a downloaded app
Enable or disable GateKeeper from one script
how_to_run: Right-click the file and choose Open the first time
notable: Single downloadable .command file with no install step
Covers status check, enable, disable, quarantine removal, and self-signing in one tool
Targets the common 'damaged app' and 'unidentified developer' error messages
caveats: The README does not state what security trade-offs disabling GateKeeper carries
The README is brief and does not document the script's internals or requirements
